complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Configure Testing Infrastructure (Jest + React Testing Library + Playwright)
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Break down the testing infrastructure setup into: (1) Install and configure Jest with Next.js compatibility and TypeScript support, (2) Set up React Testing Library with custom render utilities, (3) Install and configure Playwright for E2E testing across browsers, (4) Create test directory structure and example tests, (5) Add test scripts to package.json and verify setup. Each subtask should include TDD validation steps.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Medium-high complexity (6/10). While testing framework installation is well-documented, integrating Jest with Next.js 14 requires specific configuration for App Router, TypeScript, and module resolution (@/ alias). Playwright setup needs browser configuration and device emulation. The main challenge is ensuring compatibility between all tools and creating a working test environment from scratch. Recommended 5 subtasks to separate concerns: Jest config, RTL setup, Playwright config, directory structure, and validation.

complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Set Up CI/CD Pipeline with GitHub Actions
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Split CI/CD setup into: (1) Create test.yml workflow for linting, type-checking, and unit tests with coverage reporting, (2) Create e2e.yml workflow for Playwright tests across multiple browsers, (3) Create build.yml workflow for production build validation and bundle size checks, (4) Test all workflows with dummy tests and verify failure/success reporting. Each workflow should have proper caching and artifact management.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Medium complexity (5/10). GitHub Actions workflows are straightforward YAML configuration, but depends on Task 1 completion. Main challenges: proper Node.js/Yarn setup, caching strategies for faster builds, and ensuring workflows trigger correctly. The task is well-defined with clear acceptance criteria (coverage thresholds, build success). Recommended 4 subtasks for each workflow type plus validation step.

complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Create Project Data Structure and TypeScript Types
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Organize data structure creation into: (1) Define core TypeScript enums and interfaces (ProjectType, ProjectStatus, TechStack, Feature, etc.), (2) Create Project interface with all required fields from PRD, (3) Implement projectsData array with complete data for all 8 projects, (4) Build helper functions (getProjectById, filtering functions), (5) Write comprehensive unit tests for type validation and helper functions, (6) Export data and functions with proper documentation. Ensure data accuracy matches PRD specifications.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Medium-high complexity (7/10). This task requires careful TypeScript interface design for 8 diverse projects with different tech stacks and statuses. Challenges include: ensuring type safety for varied project types, creating comprehensive data for projects currently not in codebase (only 3 projects shown), maintaining consistency across all project data, and writing tests that validate both types and data. The task is foundational for Tasks 6 and 7, so accuracy is critical. Recommended 6 subtasks to separate type definitions, data entry, helper functions, and testing.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Break dark mode implementation into: (1) Install next-themes and create ThemeProvider wrapper component, (2) Update app/layout.tsx to integrate ThemeProvider with suppressHydrationWarning, (3) Create ThemeToggle component with Sun/Moon icons and theme switching logic, (4) Update globals.css with dark mode CSS variables and verify WCAG contrast compliance. Include TDD tests for theme persistence and system preference detection.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Low-medium complexity (4/10). next-themes is a well-established library with clear documentation. Main work involves: installing dependency, wrapping app in provider, creating toggle component (lucide-react already installed), and updating CSS variables (Tailwind already configured with CSS custom properties). Challenges: ensuring proper hydration handling, WCAG contrast validation, and theme persistence testing. Recommended 4 subtasks for clean separation of concerns and testability.

complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Build Reusable UI Components (Header, Footer, ProjectCard, StatCard)
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Create components with TDD approach: (1) Write tests and implement Header component with navigation and mobile menu, (2) Write tests and implement Footer component with 5-column responsive grid, (3) Write tests and implement ProjectCard component with image optimization and tech stack display, (4) Write tests and implement StatCard component with count-up animation, (5) Add accessibility features (ARIA labels, keyboard navigation) to all components, (6) Implement responsive behavior and test at all breakpoints, (7) Add dark mode support and styling to all components, (8) Achieve ≥90% test coverage for all components. Follow strict RED-GREEN-REFACTOR cycle for each component.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: High complexity (8/10). This task requires building 4 distinct, feature-rich components from scratch with full TDD coverage. Challenges include: replacing existing simple header/footer in app/page.tsx, implementing smooth scroll navigation, creating mobile hamburger menu with animation, building count-up animation for StatCard, ensuring responsive design across all breakpoints, maintaining accessibility standards (keyboard nav, ARIA), and achieving ≥90% test coverage. Current codebase only has basic shadcn/ui components. Recommended 8 subtasks (2 per component) to maintain TDD rigor and ensure proper testing of complex features like animations and responsive behavior.

complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Redesign Home Page with New Sections (Hero, Stats, Projects, Skills, About, Contact)
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Rebuild home page with TDD methodology: (1) Write tests and implement HeroSection with updated content and CTAs, (2) Write tests and implement StatsSection with count-up animations on scroll, (3) Write tests and implement ProjectsSection with filter tabs and pagination, (4) Write tests and implement SkillsSection with 6 categories and tech badges, (5) Enhance AboutSection with timeline and achievements, (6) Enhance ContactSection with form validation and notifications, (7) Write integration tests for section interactions (filtering, form submission), (8) Write E2E tests for full page flow and responsive behavior, (9) Verify all sections render correctly with project data and achieve ≥90% coverage. Replace existing app/page.tsx content entirely.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: High complexity (9/10). This is a major refactoring task requiring complete redesign of the home page with 6 complex sections. Challenges include: replacing all existing content in current app/page.tsx, implementing filter logic for projects (requires Task 3 data), creating scroll-triggered count-up animations, building pagination ('Load More' functionality), designing 6-category skill taxonomy, adding form validation with toast notifications, ensuring responsive design across all sections, and writing comprehensive integration + E2E tests. Current page is simple with only 3 static project cards. Recommended 9 subtasks to handle each section independently with proper TDD coverage and integration testing.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Build dynamic project pages with TDD: (1) Set up dynamic route with generateStaticParams for 8 projects, (2) Write tests and implement ProjectHero component, (3) Write tests and implement TechStackGrid component, (4) Write tests and implement FeaturesSection component, (5) Write tests and implement ScreenshotGallery with carousel/lightbox, (6) Write tests and implement AchievementsSection component, (7) Write tests and implement CodeStatsSection with visualization, (8) Write tests and implement ProjectLinks component, (9) Generate dynamic metadata for SEO, (10) Test all 8 project pages render correctly with proper 404 handling and achieve ≥90% coverage.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: High complexity (8/10). This task involves creating a complete dynamic routing system with 8 distinct sub-components, each with unique functionality. Challenges include: implementing generateStaticParams for build-time rendering, creating responsive screenshot gallery with swipe support, handling conditional rendering for available links (GitHub, App Store, npm), building data visualizations for code stats, generating dynamic Open Graph metadata for each project, ensuring 404 handling for invalid IDs, and testing all 8 projects thoroughly. No dynamic routes exist in current codebase. Recommended 10 subtasks to separate route setup, each component implementation with tests, and validation across all projects.

complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Optimize Images and Implement Next.js Image Best Practices
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Implement image optimization: (1) Create organized image directory structure for project screenshots and tech icons, (2) Configure next.config.mjs with image optimization settings and responsive sizes, (3) Replace all tags with Next/Image in existing components (currently 3 images in app/page.tsx), (4) Implement blur placeholders and lazy loading for all images, (5) Optimize and convert existing images to WebP format, validate with Lighthouse audit (target ≥90 score). Include CLS prevention and responsive srcset validation.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Medium complexity (5/10). Next.js Image component is well-documented and handles most optimization automatically. Challenges include: organizing images for 8 projects (currently only 3 screenshots exist), configuring WebP/AVIF formats, generating blur placeholders, ensuring proper width/height to prevent CLS, replacing existing tags in app/page.tsx, and validating optimization with Lighthouse. Dependencies on Tasks 6 and 7 mean more images will need optimization. Recommended 5 subtasks for directory setup, configuration, replacement, placeholder generation, and validation.

complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Implement SEO, Metadata, and Structured Data
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Implement comprehensive SEO: (1) Update app/layout.tsx with global metadata (title, description, Open Graph, Twitter Card), (2) Create app/sitemap.ts to generate sitemap.xml for all routes, (3) Create app/robots.ts for crawler configuration, (4) Implement JSON-LD structured data component (Person and CreativeWork schemas), (5) Add dynamic metadata to project detail pages (/projects/[id]), (6) Validate SEO with Lighthouse audit, Rich Results Test, and social media debuggers (target ≥90 SEO score). Ensure unique titles/descriptions for all pages.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Medium-high complexity (6/10). Next.js 14 App Router has built-in metadata API which simplifies implementation, but requires careful configuration. Challenges include: updating existing minimal metadata in app/layout.tsx and app/page.tsx, creating dynamic metadata for 8 project pages, implementing JSON-LD for structured data, generating sitemap with all routes, validating with multiple tools (Google Rich Results, Facebook/Twitter debuggers), and ensuring unique content for each page. Some metadata already exists but needs significant enhancement. Recommended 6 subtasks for global metadata, sitemap/robots, structured data, dynamic metadata, and comprehensive validation.

complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Performance Optimization and Core Web Vitals
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Optimize performance systematically: (1) Analyze bundle size with @next/bundle-analyzer and identify optimization opportunities, (2) Implement code splitting with next/dynamic for heavy components, (3) Optimize fonts using next/font (already partially done) and implement font subsetting, (4) Configure JavaScript optimization (minification, tree shaking, remove console.logs), (5) Optimize CSS by purging unused Tailwind classes and inlining critical CSS, (6) Implement caching strategy and loading states with skeleton screens, (7) Configure Cache-Control headers and static asset versioning, (8) Validate Core Web Vitals with Lighthouse, WebPageTest, and throttled 3G testing (target: LCP <2.5s, FID <100ms, CLS <0.1, Performance ≥90). Test on production build.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Medium-high complexity (7/10). Performance optimization requires measuring, analyzing, and iteratively improving multiple aspects. Challenges include: analyzing current bundle size (no analyzer configured), identifying and lazy-loading heavy components from Tasks 5-7, implementing skeleton screens for loading states, configuring advanced caching strategies, ensuring Core Web Vitals targets are met across all pages, testing on throttled networks, and maintaining performance during future development. Dependencies on Tasks 6, 7, 8, 9 mean significant content will be added. Recommended 8 subtasks to address bundle analysis, code splitting, font/JS/CSS optimization, caching, loading states, and comprehensive validation across different network conditions.
